text: N332145 April 19, 2023 CLA-2-61:OT:RR:NC:N3:358CATEGORY: ClassificationTARIFF NO.: 6106.10.0030Angie McDanielSugartown Worldwide, LLC752 S. Victory DriveLyons, GA 30436RE: The tariff classification of an upper body garment from India.Dear Ms. McDaniel:In your letter dated April 10, 2023, you requested a tariff classification ruling.  The sample will be returned on a separate cover.Style #14495 identified as “Mini-Emerie Tee,” is a girl’s upper body garment constructed of 100 percent cotton knit fabric that measures at least 10 or more stitches per linear centimeter in both directions, as indicated in your request. The loose-fitting garment extends from the shoulders to below the waist and features a rib knit crew neckline, long sleeves and a curved hemmed bottom.Based on the appearance of the garment as well as the definition and reasoning set forth in Headquarters Rulings HQ H325360 and HQ H324935, we find that style #14495 is a loose-fitting blouse of heading 6106, HTSUS.The applicable subheading for style #14495 will be 6106.10.0030, Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS), which provides for “Women’s or girl’s blouses and shirts, knitted or crocheted: Of cotton: Girls’: Other.” The rate of duty will be 19.7 percent ad valorem.Duty rates are provided for your convenience and are subject to change. The text of the most recent HTSUS and the accompanying duty rates are provided at https://hts.usitc.gov/currentThis ruling is being issued under the provisions of Part 177 of the Customs and Border Protection Regulations (19 C.F.R. 177).A copy of the ruling or the control number indicated above should be provided with the entry documents filed at the time this merchandise is imported. If you have any questions regarding the ruling, please contact National Import Specialist Katherine Souffront at katherine.souffront@cbp.dhs.gov.Sincerely, Steven A. Mack Director National Commodity Specialist Division
subject: The tariff classification of an upper body garment from India.
